firstMismatch.message: C processes the closed door at (28,5) as a door and emits the collapse message; JS reads a stale zero doormask mirror and takes the doorless pit branch.

summary: The admitted v56 earthquake recording reaches music.c:do_earthquake with a closed door whose C state is levl[x][y].flags through the rm.h doormask alias. JavaScript reads the separate legacy location.doormask field, which is zero, and sends the door through the doorless pit branch. A later secret-door variation also exposes the split field state; both differences belong to the same doormask/flags contract in do_earthquake.

source.branch: When the earthquake terrain draw selects a DOOR or SDOOR cell, C treats doormask as the rm.flags field. It creates a pit only when that canonical field is D_NODOOR; otherwise it clears the door state, updates blocking and display, reports the collapse, and bills a shop. JS currently tests and changes location.doormask alone.
callers: music.c:do_play_instrument invokes do_earthquake for DRUM_OF_EARTHQUAKE; js/apply.js:doapply calls js/music.js:do_play_instrument, which reaches js/music.js:do_earthquake.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/include/rm.h:213 defines doormask as flags, so C reads and writes one union slot.
detect.c:cvt_sdoor_to_door updates the source union slot; js/detect.js:cvt_sdoor_to_door currently mirrors flags and doormask for JS state.
music.c:do_earthquake calls do_pit on the doorless arm; JS js/music.js has the corresponding helper call.

evidence: Source trace: nethack-c/upstream/include/rm.h:213 defines doormask as flags. nethack-c/upstream/src/music.c:do_earthquake lines 458-471 handles DOOR after SDOOR conversion, checks doormask == D_NODOOR, and otherwise clears the aliased state before redraw and the collapse message.

JavaScript defect: js/music.js:do_earthquake lines 452-466 tests location.doormask and writes only that property. Generated map cells may carry the closed-door mask in location.flags while the legacy doormask property remains zero, so the JS doorless test takes the wrong arm.
Production call chain: C music.c:do_play_instrument line 698 calls do_earthquake for DRUM_OF_EARTHQUAKE. JS apply.js:doapply calls music.js:do_play_instrument, which calls music.js:do_earthquake.
